fusions.name: Thrown Scrap
fusions.desc: Hurls a scrap of link that deals 7 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Plague Run
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 9 damage and makes the target [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Tethered Pack
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm tethered to you for 14 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 3 health.

fusions.name: Gnawed Reserves
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 60 seconds.
